Every file of the archive's top folder ASIOSDK/ is copied here byte for
byte, PDFs and logo artwork included, with the ASIOSDK/ prefix dropped
(ASIOSDK/common/asio.cpp is common/asio.cpp here). Nothing is edited.

NereusSDR-added files (not from the archive):
  VERSION.txt     this file
  CMakeLists.txt  the Windows-only static library asiosdk_host, built from
                  common/asio.cpp, host/asiodrivers.cpp and
                  host/pc/asiolist.cpp

To check the copy against the archive:
  unzip -q ASIO-SDK_2.3.4_2025-10-15.zip -d /tmp/asio
  diff -r /tmp/asio/ASIOSDK third_party/asiosdk
(the only differences are the two NereusSDR-added files above).

Do not edit the SDK files in place. To update, download the new release,
check its licence, and overwrite every file here with the archive's,
then update this file, docs/attribution/ASIO-SDK-PROVENANCE.md and
packaging/third-party-licenses/asiosdk.txt and asiosdk-notices.txt.
